notes.title: Hello! Здравствуйте! 你好！
notes.content:
A new update has added Russian and Simplified Chinese languages to ROTii! This is the beginning of what will hopefully be a cleaning robot that can be played all over the world.  In addition, we snuck in a couple of bug fixes:

-Fixed a game crashing but with the ending sequence of the game.

-Some of the game's more unfair moments received some tweaks for balance. 

-Some all around stability performance tweaks for good measure. 

Happy cleaning!

notes.title: Performance Fix and New Player Welcome
notes.content:
First, we would like to say thank you and welcome to all of the new gamers who picked up ROTii during this weekend's Comicpalooza! Along with those of you who already have the game, your support is the fuel that keeps up developing! Speaking of developing, we've dropped an update to the game that should see a few improvements:

-The game should run smoother on more machines overall.

-Tweaked a few game breakers in various levels.

-Updated some of the earlier puzzles based on how gamers were performing on them.
